entities.name: The Player Planeswalker
entities.description: The second-person protagonist, a red-mana planeswalker studying hedron runes on Zendikar who fights a dragon attack and a shaman.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the quest takes place.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A village on Zendikar where the protagonist rents a room and where the dragon attacks.

entities.name: Halimar Sea
entities.description: Sea crossed to reach a merfolk enclave with a great archive.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Zendikari continent with southern hedron-fields where hedrons wrench free of the earth.

entities.name: Hedron
entities.description: Huge stone diamonds whose runes describe a planewide imprisonment of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Mordant Dragon
entities.description: A dragon that attacks Sea Gate, enchanted by the shaman, and is slain by the protagonist.

entities.name: The Minotaur
entities.description: A minotaur with a war maul who reports the dragon and joins the quest; later revealed to be the shaman's illusion.

entities.name: The Kor Artificer
entities.description: A kor artificer who built the amber orb to hold a dark fragment for a client, then is incinerated by the Novablast Wurm.

entities.name: The Dragonmaster Shaman
entities.description: A human shaman in western-tribe face-paint who commissioned the amber orb, sent the dragon, and seeks to kill a planeswalker.

entities.name: Orb of Amber
entities.description: A fist-sized amber orb built to contain and direct a dark fragment's power, set at the end of the shaman's staff.

entities.name: Novablast Wurm
entities.description: A wurm with coils of white energy that appears and kills the kor artificer.

entities.name: The Eldrazi
entities.description: Horrors imprisoned on Zendikar, a fragment of which rises from the orb.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Merfolk of an enclave beyond the Halimar Sea who grant access to their archives.

events.summary: A minotaur kicks down the protagonist's study door to report a dragon.
The dragon attacks Sea Gate with a column of caustic fire.
events.quote: A column of caustic fire rains down on you.

events.summary: The protagonist blasts a hole in the dragon's wing; it flees and buildings burn.
events.quote: Your blast of electrical mayhem tore a nasty hole right through the dragon's wing membrane.

events.summary: The protagonist and minotaur find the dragon enchanted and defeat it.
events.quote: You and your minotaur companion have taken down the Mordant Dragon that plagued the residents of Sea Gate.

events.summary: A necromantic vision shows an amber orb as the source of influence on the dragon.
events.quote: There's one symbol that stands out lucidly in your mind: a fist-sized orb of amber, golden and translucent as fire.

events.summary: The merfolk grant access to their archives, where the protagonist finds the orb's link to a kor artificer.
events.quote: The merfolk agree to grant you access to their archives

events.summary: In Tazeem the hedrons rise and a living hedron-creature attacks.
events.quote: the enormous hedrons that lay dormant in the fields for centuries have begun to wrench free of the earth.

events.summary: The protagonist defeats the kor artificer in a duel and learns of the amber orb and the shaman client.
events.quote: She tells the story of how a client once gave her a fragment of glossy black material, obsidian in color but otherworldly in texture, and told her to build a prison for it.

events.summary: The Novablast Wurm incinerates the kor artificer and is then defeated.
events.quote: there is a horrific, ground-shaking roar, and the kor woman is incinerated in a flash of light.

events.summary: The minotaur turns on the protagonist and strikes a crushing blow.
events.quote: He attacks you, swinging his war maul and landing a crushing blow, hurling you into the air like a limp doll!

events.summary: The illusion is dispelled and the minotaur is revealed to be the dragonmaster shaman, who wants to kill a planeswalker.
events.quote: The image of the minotaur and his war maul crumbles away, revealing a human woman, a fierce-looking shaman carrying a mystic staff.

events.summary: The protagonist destroys the shaman's staff.
events.quote: You summon forces of nature to destroy the staff

events.summary: The shaman summons an ancient Zendikari dragon while the protagonist summons creatures.
events.quote: The two of you square off, mage to mage.

events.summary: The protagonist calls on Zendikar's elementals and defeats the dragonmaster.
events.quote: The dragonmaster—and her vendetta against you—lie defeated.

events.summary: An Eldrazi rises from the cracked orb and is defeated, revealing the hedron runes describe an Eldrazi prison.
events.quote: You defeat the horrendous Eldrazi creature, saving the continent of Tazeem from its destruction.

relations.note: commissioned the orb from the kor artificer
relations.quote: she built the amber orb to contain and direct its power.
the kor woman is incinerated in a flash of light.
You had been on Zendikar for months, studying the runes of a strange stone hedron

relations.note: disguised as the minotaur by illusion
relations.quote: The image of the minotaur and his war maul crumbles away, revealing a human woman, a fierce-looking shaman carrying a mystic staff.
